records.plan:
# Capture with --fixture-loop --fresh-boot on the original EU04 snapshot.
# Load the original DOC_LOOP through Settings > Samples.
wait 1000
tap STOP
press TRK
tap 1
release TRK
tap GLOBAL
tap DOWN
tap YES
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap YES
tap RIGHT
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap YES
tap YES
wait 1500
tap NO
tap LEFT
tap GLOBAL
tap SRC
# DOC_LOOP occupies the first empty sample slot, slot 1 in this project.
turn D -160 100
turn D 2 300
tap AMP
tap SRC
wait 700
snap sample-parameters
tap SRC
wait 700
snap sample-waveform
press FUNC
turn E 1 400
release FUNC
wait 100
snap sample-snapped
tap AMP
tap SRC
wait 700
snap waveform-settled

fixture.name: DOC_LOOP
fixture.source: Original generated one-second percussive tone, 48 kHz mono PCM

records.frameSelection: One complete unmodified firmware framebuffer from the final 250 ms, chosen by populated pixels; nearest-neighbor 6x scaling.
limitations: UI documentation only; no hardware, timing or audio-quality qualification.
The crossfade image is a retained regression frame on the same MAIN; the button plan recreates the SRC images only.

This does not show a public import command for loaded samples or RAM takes.
